jobs.description_text: About the Role Anduril designs and fields systems across an unusually broad materials portfolio. Advancing our products depends on trusted, analysis-ready material data across this full range of materials, generated and governed at the pace our programs move. This role owns the enterprise materials database: building it, filling it, governing it, and making it the place Anduril's design values come from. This role is your opportunity to establish the infrastructure, methodology, and governance that turn materials characterization and qualification into a defined workflow — and build the system that holds the output. You'll decide what a material record looks like, how test data gets into it, what makes a value trustworthy enough to release, and how the rest of engineering consumes it. It’s your opportunity to set a technical standard and get an organization to adopt it. Shape how materials engineering gets done, not just what gets tested. You’ll build the foundation and scale it. What You'll Do Build the Materials Database . Own the materials database end to end — data model and schema, units and provenance, revision control, access, and release. Define how a material, a form, a process, a lot, and a test result relate to one another so a design value can always be traced back to the specimens behind it. Stand up the ingest paths that feed it: test lab deliverables, LIMS and test-frame output, supplier certs, and legacy data scattered across spreadsheets and program drives. E

Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites.
